subject: Request: AWS marketplace carveout pricing for Aurora Health pilot
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: lchen@aurorahealth.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: AWS marketplace carveout request for Aurora Health pilot

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Aurora's pilot looks high-impact and we'd love to move forward on the AWS Marketplace listing, but we need to square pricing for the initial 12-month pilot to match Aurora's procurement constraints.

Quick ask: would Aurora be able to accept a 20% off our published marketplace list price for the first 12 months if Aurora commits to the pilot and a published listing (Marketplace Private Offer) that will enable co-sell? We can structure the discount as a time-limited marketplace credit.

Important details for procurement:
- Estimated first-year spend: $120,000 committed
- Expected go-live (pilot): Oct 2026
- Use-case: document ingestion + triage workflows

I attached a draft proposal (Aurora_AWS_MA_proposal.pdf) with the commercial terms and a suggested SOW. If you can share procurement's target or confirm the discount band, I will escalate internally to the deal desk and finance for a carveout approval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our marketplace listing timeline is tight.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: Aurora_AWS_MA_proposal.pdf (pdf, 212 KB)

To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace carveout request for Aurora Health pilot

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the proposal. Procurement asked me to confirm the following before you escalate:
1) Is the 20% off list a hard discount or a marketplace credit that will be applied at purchase?
2) Can Redwood guarantee that the discounted offer will be visible via Private Offer flow so Aurora can pay through AWS?
3) Any restrictions on seat counts or token usage caps during the pilot?

From procurement: ideally we need the discount applied on invoice (through AWS Private Offer) and an audit trail for spend.

I forwarded this to procurement; procurement@aurorahealth.com will follow up with the PO details.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Head of Digital Transformation
Aurora Health

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AWS marketplace carveout request — need pricing carveout assessment (Aurora)

Team — forwarding Aurora's ask. Summary below and ask is for a carveout approval recommendation so we can respond to procurement.

Summary:
- Customer: Aurora Health (regional health system)
- Ask: 20% off published marketplace list for first 12 months; applied via AWS Private Offer so Aurora pays via AWS invoice.
- Committed first-year ARR (pilot + expand): $120k
- Strategic rationale: referenceable healthcare pilot, strong chance to expand to 6 hospitals in 2027, co-sell with AWS sales engineering already engaged.

Attached: Aurora_SOW_v2.docx (SOW v2) and the initial proposal.

Requesting:
1) Deal desk: is 20% off marketplace list allowable for a Private Offer / co-sell path?
2) Finance: what guardrails (rev recognition, clawback, credit treatment) should we apply?
3) Marketplace ops (Vanessa): what listing/PO flow constraints exist for a temporary promotional credit vs. permanent list change?

Proposed fallback if full 20% not allowed: offer 15% marketplace credit + $15k onboarding credit (off-invoice) if we can get AWS co-sell support.

Lauren
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aurora_SOW_v2.docx (docx, 95 KB)
From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS marketplace carveout request — assessment and recommendation

Lauren / team —

Thanks for the precise summary. High-level assessment:
- Commercial: $120k committed ARR is meaningful for a pilot but below our standard enterprise threshold for deeper discounts.
- Marketplace policy: our standard public listing discount cap is 15% without revenue engineering approval; Private Offers can be used to route discounts but require finance sign-off for revenue treatment.
- Co-sell: AWS co-sell interest increases strategic value; if AWS SEs put active pipeline weight behind this, I am comfortable with a larger short-term concession.

Recommendation: Approve structured carveout with these constraints:
- 18% marketplace credit for first 12 months (applied through Private Offer)
- Customer must commit to $120k ARR in the first 12 months and provide a PO within 30 days
- Offer conditioned on AWS co-sell engagement (SE note) and no retrospective list changes
- Finance to treat the credit as a marketing/promotional credit with a 12-month clawback if Aurora terminates early

If Finance cannot accept 18% as credit treatment, fallback is the 15% credit + $15k onboarding credit off-invoice as Lauren suggested.

Aditya Rao
Head of Field Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS marketplace carveout request — final approval (Aurora)

Team —

Reviewed with finance and marketplace ops. Given the strategic nature (healthcare reference, AWS co-sell engagement) and the committed first-year spend, finance will approve a one-time temporary marketplace credit structured as follows:

- Approved concession: 20% marketplace credit for first 12 months, delivered via AWS Private Offer (Marketplace credit applied at purchase)
- Conditions: Aurora must sign the PO within 21 days and commit to $120k ARR; credit will be subject to a 12-month clawback if contract terminated early
- Accounting treatment: credit recorded as contra-revenue marketing credit; no change to published list price
- Ops: Vanessa, please confirm Private Offer flow and ensure a DocuSign workflow for acceptance.

Attaching formal approval stub: Deal_Approval_0912.pdf

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference
